parent_objective: design a fair bounded training-smoke protocol for L0/L1/L2/L3 profile comparison after runtime instantiation passes
blocked_by: profile runtime smoke passes but training smoke should not start without a pre-registered fair resource-capped protocol
supersedes: launching generated profile training directly after runtime smoke
invalidates: claiming profile comparability from runtime instantiation alone

public_gates: M1193 may design controller profile training-smoke protocol only
M1193 must not train controller weights
M1193 must not run candidate replay
M1193 must not use private holdout
M1193 must not add hidden or oracle actor inputs
forbidden_shortcuts: do not tune per profile from early results
do not add hidden or oracle actor inputs
do not claim profile superiority from a design document

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: defines the smallest resource-capped training smoke that can test profile training plumbing without turning into a performance comparison
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design only; no training replay PPO promotion private-holdout driver-performance recurrent-belief or paper-result claim
stop_condition: stop if the protocol would compare profiles with unequal seeds budgets env distributions or gate criteria
stop if it requires private holdout
stop if it begins training instead of designing the run
stop if L2_window_100 cost makes all-profile smoke infeasible without staged admission
fallback_plan: if all eight profiles are too costly, design a two-stage L0/L1/L2_window_25/L3 pilot followed by full-window expansion
if generated smoke configs need train_ppo integration for runtime masks, route to integration implementation first
if recurrent hidden reset semantics are not executable, keep L3_reset_control out of first training smoke and document the block
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1192 runtime smoke passed and training should not start without a fair pre-registered protocol

admission_evidence: M1190 generated eight profile smoke configs
M1191 runtime mask wrapper tests pass
M1192 all generated profiles instantiate with runtime masks and model forwards
blocked_shortcuts: do not train controllers in M1193
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, review, and next manifest
next_stage_criteria: shared seeds budgets env splits and metrics are fixed
runtime mask train_ppo integration risk is explicitly handled
resource cap and fallback ladder are fixed
next implementation or run milestone is selected

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1193 designs controls for L0/L1/L2/L3 comparison but does not test history necessity.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1193 may define windows but does not evaluate temporal evidence.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If a fair smoke protocol cannot be designed, keep training blocked and route to profile integration or resource-scope repair.
allowed_claims: no self-identification, driver capability, promotion, private-holdout, real-vehicle, or paper-result claim

hypothesis: A fair resource-capped training-smoke protocol can be designed for generated L0/L1/L2/L3 configs without starting training or weakening input-contract controls.
success_criteria: protocol fixes profile set, seeds, budgets, env split, metrics, gates, resource cap, and fallback ladder
runtime mask train_ppo integration requirement is explicitly handled before L0 training
no controller training, candidate replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, or actor-input contract change occurs
next implementation or run milestone is selected
failure_criteria: protocol gives profiles unequal budgets or per-profile tuning
runtime mask training integration risk is ignored
hidden or oracle actor inputs are introduced

commands.name: design_profile_training_smoke
commands.command: write bounded fair training-smoke protocol without running training

decision_rule: M1193 passes if it defines a fair resource-capped training-smoke protocol and keeps actual controller training blocked.
